idea-plugin.name: Manage Scheduled Events
idea-plugin.description:
See every scheduled job in your Java/Spring project in one place: Spring @Scheduled methods and Quartz jobs, with their crons explained in plain English.

The "Scheduled Events" tool window lets you browse jobs, check and edit their crons, and jump to source:

  • Spring @Scheduled methods and Quartz jobs (Job / QuartzJobBean) with their cron triggers
  • Crons described in words and validated, using Spring or Quartz rules as appropriate
  • Edit a cron in place: it is written back to the code or config file it comes from
  • Crons read from application.yml / .properties through ${...} placeholders, @Value or @ConfigurationProperties, with profile overrides shown
  • Grouping by class, by package, or a flat list of jobs
  • Sorting by name or by how often jobs run
  • Optional ShedLock helpers: add/remove @SchedulerLock on all @Scheduled methods when ShedLock is present

Quartz triggers are found where a cron is passed to CronScheduleBuilder.cronSchedule(...), CronTriggerFactoryBean.setCronExpression(...) or CronTriggerImpl.setCronExpression(...), and matched to their job through the JobDetail they are built with.

ShedLock ensures that scheduled tasks run on a single node in clustered environments. When enabled, this plugin can add @SchedulerLock(name = "ClassName_methodNameLock") right after @Scheduled, and will manage imports for net.javacrumbs.shedlock.spring.annotation.SchedulerLock. You can later tweak parameters like lockAtLeastFor / lockAtMostFor as needed. Learn more at ShedLock.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.1.0:
    • Quartz support: lists Job / QuartzJobBean classes with their cron triggers, validated and described with Quartz cron rules (year field, L, W, #)
    • Crons from application.yml / .properties: ${...} placeholders in @Scheduled, @Value and @ConfigurationProperties getters are resolved, including ${key:default} and profile overrides
    • Editing a cron that comes from a config file updates the config file
    • Crons from constants are now shown, e.g. @Scheduled(cron = DAILY)
    • @Scheduled(fixedRate/fixedDelay) methods show "<no cron>" instead of an empty cron
    • Quartz jobs scheduled at runtime, e.g. with crons kept in the application's own table, can be loaded from Quartz's QRTZ_ tables through a data source in the Database tool window (IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate), read-only, with trigger state and next fire time
    • Quartz triggers built in helper methods are matched to their job through the methods that call them, and crons passed in as arguments are followed to where they come from
    • Now requires the bundled YAML and Properties plugins
  • 1.0.1:
    • Sorting: switch between sorting by name and by frequency (most often running jobs first)
    • New "Jobs only" grouping that shows a flat list of scheduled methods
    • ShedLock actions are hidden when ShedLock is not on the classpath
    • Fixed a crash when a scheduled method was edited or removed while listed; a warning is now shown if a cron change can't be saved
  • 1.0.0: Initial release (browse and navigate @Scheduled methods; search; grouping; expand/collapse) ShedLock support (toolbar actions to add/remove @SchedulerLock; quick navigation to enable ShedLock)
